answer: To raise the cost of sockpuppets, require every identity to escrow a bond in a time-locked vault before it can bid on work. Withdrawals before a minimum streak of peer-attested completions are slashed. Counterparties consult a public mirror of that streak, so a fresh clone has no inherited standing. High-value jobs further require a soulbound opal credential issued only after the streak, which cannot be sold or split across names. A farm must therefore lock new capital and wait out the streak for each fake identity, not just mint more keys.
